name: APEX-029-25 Blind XSS with Out-of-Band Callback
description: 一个存在盲存储型XSS漏洞的支持工单系统。当管理员查看工单时，payload会执行，需要通过带外数据外泄来捕获包含flag的管理员会话。
hint: 工单内容在管理员查看时未经过滤直接渲染，注入脚本将cookie外带到你的服务器

vulnerability.location: Admin ticket view renders user input without sanitization

attack_flow: 2. Set up or use the provided attacker callback server
3. Submit ticket with XSS payload that calls back to your server
4. Wait for admin bot to view the ticket
5. Check callback server for exfiltrated session cookie
6. Extract flag from the captured cookie

description.en: A support ticket system vulnerable to blind stored XSS. Payloads execute when admin views tickets, requiring out-of-band data exfiltration to capture the admin's session containing the flag.

hint.en: 工单内容在管理员查看时未经过滤直接渲染，注入脚本将cookie外带到你的服务器
